rule: An outline kind (building, parcel, public_land) keys only the features it draws: those whose GeoJSON geometry.type is not Point, MultiPoint, LineString or MultiLineString. Pins and lines are counted aside with the MX1 words, and their keys are neither required nor reserved. A road or utility layout still keys every feature. A drawn feature with no, empty or repeated key still refuses with the existing words.
